research_question: Can previous-available-UTC-day Volume Profile value-area edges become executable 30-second XAUUSD reversal anchors when a causal failed auction is confirmed by directional tick delta, without post-result tuning?
rationale: Completed R037 meta-harvest repeatedly favors durable anchors plus delayed causal confirmation/retest over raw indicators and naked breakouts.
17BK session VWAP showed better M5 economics but insufficient supply; this unit changes the anchor mechanism to prior-day auction distribution rather than retuning VWAP.
Prior PDH/PDL sweep/reclaim is retired; this is not a PDH/PDL rescue. VAH/VAL are volume-distribution boundaries and the delta lane adds participation confirmation.

source_basis.use: directional volume classification and accumulation semantics
reconstructible signed tick-volume proxy logic for MT5/forex

source_basis.source: Reddit XAUUSD previous-day Volume Profile discussion
source_basis.use: community evidence that VAH/VAL sweep-close-back-inside needs context/confirmation rather than blind edge fading

profile_construction.source: prior available UTC trading day only
profile_construction.price: native Dukascopy midpoint quantized to frozen $0.01 raw tick
profile_construction.row_size: one frozen $0.01 price tick; no row-count optimization
profile_construction.poc: price row with maximum tick count; deterministic lower-price tie break
profile_construction.value_area: expand outward from POC using adjacent-row tick counts until the 70% target is reached; deterministic lower-price tie break
profile_construction.causality: current-day signals may use only a completed prior available UTC trading-day profile

delta_proxy.tick_classification: +1 on uptick, -1 on downtick, 0 on unchanged tick
delta_proxy.bar_delta: sum signed tick classifications inside the completed confirmation bar
delta_proxy.role: confirmation sign only; no numeric delta threshold

event_grammar.short_edge: completed bar high strictly above prior-day VAH, then close strictly back below VAH with bearish body
event_grammar.long_edge: completed bar low strictly below prior-day VAL, then close strictly back above VAL with bullish body
event_grammar.delta_confirmation: when enabled, short requires bar delta < 0 and long requires bar delta > 0
event_grammar.entry: first executable P75 tick at or after confirming completed bar end
event_grammar.rearm: after an edge event, that side rearms only after a completed bar no longer touches the boundary (high < VAH for short edge; low > VAL for long edge)
event_grammar.ownership: global frozen one-position-at-a-time evaluator; no side/session/day filter

gates.advance_rule: Advance only unchanged profile(s) meeting all activity gates and nonnegative direct net to independent later-January validation.

prohibited: no PDH/PDL or VWAP rescue overlay
